name: Ontotext GraphDB (now Graphwise GraphDB)
tier_reason: Leading commercial RDF store; EOIP has a GraphDBGraphStore adapter (BL-06); reference for forward-chaining materialisation, SHACL, cluster
members: Talk to Your Graph / MCP prompts
owner: Graphwise (merger of Ontotext and Semantic Web Company, announced 2024-10-23)
release_cadence: minor roughly every 2-4 months, patches every 2-3 weeks after a minor
license: Proprietary EULA; GraphDB Free (single-core licence file) and Enterprise (core-based); Standard edition no longer offered
redistribution_notes: Closed source; licence file required in every edition since 11.0.0; Free-edition commercial/OEM/embedding terms NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED; EOIP must only reach it over SPARQL, never bundle.
legal_review_reason: Proprietary, core-licensed, licence file at start-up; OEM/white-label and air-gap use need vendor agreement; EE core threshold conflicting in sources.
community_vs_enterprise: Free: single core, no cluster, no Solr/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/Kafka connectors. Enterprise: Raft cluster, those connectors, SLA.
resolution_note: Ontotext + SWC merged into Graphwise (2024-10-23); GraphDB and PoolParty brands persist; docs migrated to help.graphwise.ai. Oakley Capital majority stake is an UNCONFIRMED third-party report. EOIP baseline BL-06 should be restated: adapter is a local dict cache and SparqlProtocolHandler returns synthetic bindings (rdf_backend.py:72-210, sparql_protocol.py:124-152).
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as optional customer-licensed RDF backend over SPARQL only; BUILD derivation ledger and explanation; REUSE SHACL via pySHACL/Jena not GraphDB; REJECT rebuilding its cluster

sources.title: Semantic Web Company and Ontotext merge to create Graphwise

name: Apache Jena (TDB2, Fuseki, rules, SHACL)
tier_reason: Apache-2.0 reference RDF stack; EOIP has a FusekiGraphStore adapter; SPARQL/SHACL/rule oracle
redistribution_notes: Embedding, OEM and SaaS permitted with notices; transitive dependency licences not audited; run Fuseki as sidecar for a Python product.
legal_review_reason: Permissive; only routine dependency-licence audit and NOTICE handling.
community_vs_enterprise: None; single OSS project. Third-party commercial support exists (not researched).
resolution_note: Brief said latest 5.x; current line is 6.x (Java 21 minimum, Fuseki WAR retirement planned). RDF 1.2 experimental preview since 5.4.0; 6.x completeness UNVERIFIED. W3C: RDF 1.2 Concepts is Candidate Recommendation Snapshot 2026-04-07; SPARQL 1.2 Query is Working Draft 2026-10-25.
decision_summary: INTEGRATE Fuseki/TDB2 as default Apache-2.0 RDF backend over SPARQL; REUSE jena-shacl/CLI as conformance oracle; EXPERIMENT with rule engines for small ontologies; DEFER RDF 1.2

name: Zingg
tier_reason: OSS ML entity resolution; candidate to close BL-36 (probabilistic ER absent); AGPL and open-core split
license: GNU AGPL-3.0 (Community, verified from LICENSE); proprietary licence for Enterprise features
redistribution_notes: Community is AGPL-3.0; shipping, linking or modifying-and-serving it inside a white-label product raises AGPL questions; Enterprise terms and pricing not published in pages read; run process-isolated as customer-installed batch job.
legal_review_reason: AGPL-3.0 core (network-use clause, combined-work questions, models/example assets), open-core Enterprise gating, dependency licences unaudited.
community_vs_enterprise: Community: active learning, learned blocking, train/match/link. Enterprise-only: incremental runs with persistent ZINGG_ID, deterministic matching, verifyBlocking, explainOutput, reassignZinggId, approval, native Snowflake.
resolution_note: Telemetry (collectMetrics) defaults to true and sends usage metrics to Google Analytics; disable for air-gap. Requires JVM/Spark (Java 11 build target, Spark 3.4/3.5, Scala 2.12).
decision_summary: REUSE Splink first for CAP-31; INTEGRATE Zingg only as optional process-isolated batch after legal review; BUILD merge/split ledger and explanations; EXPERIMENT with active-learning and learned-blocking patterns

name: Ontop (virtual knowledge graph / OBDA)
tier_reason: Leading OBDA/virtual KG engine; seed inversion target (Master Prompt 10.5); INTEGRATE candidate for CAP-21/CAP-29
owner: Ontop project (Free University of Bozen-Bolzano, Ontopic s.r.l.; contributors Birkbeck, Southeast University)
redistribution_notes: Permissive; CLA files in repo; JDBC drivers for Oracle/DB2/SQL Server are operator-supplied (not bundled: UNVERIFIED); Ontopic commercial terms not researched.
legal_review_reason: Permissive; routine dependency-licence and JDBC-driver review only. Ontopic ownership (Digital Science acquisition) UNVERIFIED.
community_vs_enterprise: OSS Ontop is the engine; Ontopic Studio/Suite adds UI, deployment and support (mapping-governance features UNVERIFIED).
resolution_note: Seed hypothesis 10.5 (OBDA read-mostly, mapping-heavy) PARTLY VALIDATED: read-only, manual mappings and no mapping versioning confirmed; but Ontop already runs the same mappings virtually and via materialize, so the new value is a hybrid policy layer, mapping versioning and ACLs. GraphDB virtual repositories use Ontop. EOIP mapping/virtualization.py is a mock with string-interpolated SQL (lines 59-80).
decision_summary: INTEGRATE Ontop as sidecar for CAP-21/CAP-29 and materialize as a governed batch source; BUILD hybrid virtualise/materialise policy, mapping versioning and ACL enforcement; DEFER RDF 1.2
